name: GDPR
summary: EU General Data Protection Regulation — obligations for collecting, processing, and retaining personal data of EU/EEA residents.

requirements.summary: Establish + record a lawful basis for each processing purpose (Art. 6).
Where consent is the basis, capture freely-given, specific, opt-in consent and allow withdrawal (Art. 7).
Provide a privacy notice describing what's collected, why, retention, and rights (Art. 13–14).
Support access, rectification, erasure, portability, and objection requests (Art. 15–22).
Collect only data adequate, relevant, and limited to the purpose (Art. 5(1)(c)).
Define + enforce retention limits; delete/anonymize when no longer needed (Art. 5(1)(e)).
Special-category data (health, biometrics, etc.) needs an Art. 9 condition + heightened safeguards.
Notify the supervisory authority of a breach within 72 hours (Art. 33).
